input.summary: Add Corio right to terminate for convenience on 30 days' notice with pro-rata refund of prepaid fees
input.comment: [Playbook] We have added a customer right to terminate for convenience on thirty (30) days' notice with a pro-rata refund of prepaid fees, since the five-year committed term currently locks us in with no exit other than breach or insolvency. If you prefer, we can move to our fallback of 60 days' notice.

ops.text: Termination for Convenience. Corio may terminate this Agreement, in whole or in part, for convenience upon thirty (30) days' prior written notice to Commerce One, without payment of any termination fee, penalty or other charge. In such event, Commerce One shall refund to Corio any prepaid fees allocable to the period after the effective date of such termination.
